text.en:
The National Council for Children's Teievision is
hereby transferred from the Office of the President to the Department of
POMA Hologram # 19590

All orders, issuances, rules and regulations, or parts
thereof which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby
repealed or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 5TH day of MAY
Our Lord, Two Thousand and Three.
in the year of
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
PMS LIBRARY BCODE009495
PONA Hologram * 19591
